claim: A cell-map renderer that diffs two maps and copies changed cells has no pixel-level attribute clash; its visible fault is a figure's cell hiding what is behind it.

evidence.text: Two cell maps (tile set, tile index, attribute) diffed and changed cells copied; figures move in whole cells, so no pixel-level attribute clash, and the visible fault is square cut-outs where a figure's cell hides the background cell. From survey counts and disassembly, not a probe.
evidence.quote: Figures move in whole cells: no pixel-level attribute clash.
